listing.name: 11eyes CrossOver — project-eleven (ThePlayer14)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Source-build instructions exist. The extent of boot and gameplay support is unknown. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own 11eyes CrossOver Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. This guide does not specify the exact supported region, revision or file hash. Check the project’s original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract project-eleven source archive, run ReXGlue codegen on own XEX and compile CMake target.
